Public scrutiny forces executive officials to publicly account for localized operational tactics and defend civil liberties.

Confusing WHAT (statutory removal orders) with WHO (the emotional reality of affected families), framing policy debate as moral villainy.

The Unavoidable Truth: Immigration enforcement follows statutory congressional frameworks.

The Unavoidable Lie: Either side is acting solely out of pure humanitarianism or unmitigated malice.
